title: A4: acceptance: unmodified stock JMAP Chat clients against mimid-agent, two agents via a mimid server
description: Mark 2026-10-18: the .13 plan must include an acceptance test that unmodified stock JMAP Chat clients (crate-jmapchat-client, jmap-chat-js) work against mimid-agent. Test: two agents (alice@a, bob@b) on two mimid servers (or one), each driven by crate-jmap's jmap-chat-client: create a group, add the other, exchange messages, both see them; then jmap-chat-js in a headless browser for one of them. Plus crate-jmap-chat-server's testkit conformance against the A2 backend where it applies.
close_reason: Merged (7ef3a5f): stock jmap-chat-client (crate-jmap 573c573) passes unmodified incl. SSE push (crates/mimid-agent/tests/stock_rust_client.rs); jmap-chat-js 9934223 passes Vitest 3/3 and Playwright 3/3 with one fetch wrapper adding the token (tools/acceptance/jmap-chat-js). Conformance suite not runnable without a test-only ConformanceBackend in mimid-agent-jmap.
